WITH grp AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE o.amount > 2802
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM grp
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - ov.overall_avg AS diff
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN overall ov
WHERE g.avg_amount > ov.overall_avg
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
